paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-2 evaluation.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our), on the QA-2 evaluation task, categorized into Correct, Partially Correct, and Incorrect responses. The horizontal axis represents the models, while the vertical axis represents the percentage or proportion of responses. The Correct, Partially Correct, and Incorrect categories are color-coded with dark blue, medium blue, and light blue, respectively. Each model's bar is segmented into these three categories, with EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 showing 92.9% Correct, 2.9% Partially Correct, and 4.3% Incorrect, and RedWhale (our) showing 95.7% Correct, 1.4% Partially Correct, and 2.9% Incorrect. The values for Correct range from approximately 92.9 to 95.7, with the highest being RedWhale (our) at 95.7 and the lowest being EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 at 92.9. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
